goal: In Google Sheets, record a macro named 'FormatHeader' that formats the active row with Bold (Cmd+B) and Center alignment, save the macro, and apply it to a new header row.

input_purposes: URL to create a new Google Sheet
Name for the recorded macro in the save dialog
required_sequence: Select 'Use relative references' and apply Bold (Cmd+B) and Center alignment
Type new headers in A1:B1 and run Extensions > Macros > FormatHeader
Verify headers are styled and select done
success: A macro named 'FormatHeader' is recorded and saved under Extensions > Macros
Target header cells display Bold and centered formatting
